f.statement: Safety monitoring must always keep in mind the minimisation of risks to participants, ensuring that the potential benefits of the clinical trial carry greater weight, in order to protect participants' rights, safety, dignity and well-being.
f.applicability: Clinical trials with medicines and biological products conducted in Brazil under RDC 945/2024 (Anvisa COPEC manual, 2nd edition 2025, non-binding guidance).

f.title: Consider other safety-relevant occurrences in safety monitoring
f.statement: Besides adverse events, other occurrences that may affect participant safety must be considered in safety monitoring because they may alter the benefit-risk balance of the investigational product or trial(s); examples include lack of efficacy in a life-threatening disease, an important new non-clinical safety finding (e.g. carcinogenicity), a temporary interruption or termination of a trial in another country for safety reasons, and relevant DSMB recommendations (e.g. on an increased frequency or severity of an expected adverse reaction).
f.applicability: Clinical trials with medicines and biological products conducted in Brazil under RDC 945/2024 (Anvisa COPEC manual, 2nd edition 2025, non-binding guidance).

do(s) ensaio(s) clínico(s). São exemplos de acontecimentos relevantes: um achado de risco
para uma população de pacientes, como a falta de eficácia do medicamento experimental
usado para o tratamento de uma doença com risco de vida; um achado de segurança
importante observado em um estudo não clínico recém-concluído (como por ex.,
carcinogenicidade); uma interrupção/término temporário de um ensaio clínico em outro país
por razões de segurança; recomendações do Comitê de Monitoramento de Dados de
Segurança, quando relevantes para a segurança dos participantes, relacionadas, por exemplo,
a um aumento na frequência ou gravidade de uma reação adversa esperada; dentre outros.

f.title: Definition: SUSAR (serious, unexpected and suspected)
f.statement: A SUSAR is an adverse reaction that simultaneously meets the conditions of being serious, unexpected and having a reasonable possibility of a causal relationship (suspected) with the investigational medicinal product or active comparator.

f.title: Definition: "related" causality and "reasonable possibility"
f.statement: Causality is considered "related" if, after analysis of the relevant data, there is evidence of a "reasonable possibility" of a causal relationship for the individual case; "reasonable possibility" generally means there are facts (evidence) or arguments suggesting a causal relationship.

f.title: Definition: adverse event (AE)
f.statement: An adverse event is any untoward medical occurrence in a trial participant given an investigational product, not necessarily causally related to the treatment: any unfavourable and unintended sign (e.g. abnormal laboratory finding), symptom or disease temporarily associated with use of a medicine, whether or not considered related.

clínico a quem um produto sob investigação foi administrado e que não necessariamente
